title: "DGT touch bias"

# Data preparation

## Load the libraries

```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
```

## Load adults and children data

```{r include=FALSE}
child_df <- read_csv('Children_data.csv')
adult_df <- read_csv('adult_data.csv')
```


## Preprocess the data

```{r include=FALSE}
child_df <- child_df %>%
  mutate(
    right_fix = case_when(
      direction == '17' & first_fix == 0 ~ 0,
      direction == '17' & first_fix == 1 ~ 1,
      direction == '71' & first_fix == 1 ~ 0,
      direction == '71' & first_fix == 0 ~ 1
    )
  )
```

```{r include=FALSE}
adult_df <- adult_df %>%
  mutate(
    right_fix = case_when(
      direction == '17' & first_fix == 0 ~ 0,
      direction == '17' & first_fix == 1 ~ 1,
      direction == '71' & first_fix == 1 ~ 0,
      direction == '71' & first_fix == 0 ~ 1
    )
  )
```

```{r include=FALSE}
children_fix <- child_df %>%
  select(sub, gender, image_no, right_fix, age_group)

adult_fix <- adult_df %>%
  select(sub, gender, image_no, right_fix) %>%
  mutate(age_group = 'Adults') %>%
  mutate(sub = sub + 500)

combined_df <- bind_rows(adult_fix, children_fix)
```

# Plot the data

## Compute the percentage

```{r include=FALSE}
sub_data <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(sub, age_group, gender) %>%
  summarise(Percentage = mean(right_fix==1), .groups = 'drop')
```
## The box plot

```{r}

ggplot(sub_data, aes(x = age_group, y = Percentage, fill = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", color="green", size=3, shape=18, position=position_dodge(width=0.75)) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("Female", "Male")) +
  labs(
    x    = "Age Group",
    y    = "Percentage of First Touch on Right Face",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")
```

# LMM
```{r}

# Fit Model 1: Additive model (without interaction)
model1_right <- glmer(right_fix ~ gender + age_group + (1 | sub), 
                      family = binomial(link = "logit"), 
                      data = combined_df)

# Fit Model 2: Interaction model
model2_right <- glmer(right_fix ~ gender * age_group + (1 | sub), 
                      family = binomial(link = "logit"), 
                      data = combined_df)

# Compare candidate models using Likelihood Ratio Test
anova(model1_right, model2_right)
```
```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model1_right, ~ gender + age_group, type = "response")
test(emm, null = 0, type = "logit", p.adjust = "bonferroni")
```


# T-tests
```{r}
# Step 1: Calculate the proportion of rightward choices for each subject
sub_summary <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(sub, gender, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    right_ratio = mean(right_fix, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: Perform one-sample t-tests against 0.5 (chance level) for each subgroup
right_bias_results <- sub_summary %>%
  group_by(age_group, gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_ratio = mean(right_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ratio = sd(right_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    t_stat = t.test(right_ratio, mu = 0.5)$statistic,
    df = t.test(right_ratio, mu = 0.5)$parameter,
    p_val = t.test(right_ratio, mu = 0.5)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bonf = p.adjust(p_val, method = "bonferroni") # Apply Bonferroni correction
  )

# View the test results
print(right_bias_results)
```
